counting_convention: Five substantive mathematical approach passes. Source lookup and finite control calls are not extra passes. No unfinished proof search is delegated to verification.
completion_estimate_meaning: Subjective progress toward full resolution; not a correctness probability or a claim that 5 percent of cases are solved.

passes.mechanism: Abelian finite quotient reconstruction and compression of homology-dual surfaces
passes.proved: Explicit p-power Hom-count formula recovers abelianization; finite-index Betti profiles correspond; positive b1 produces an essential surface in closed orientable irreducible manifolds.
passes.gap: Separating surfaces in rational homology spheres are homologically zero. Virtual positive b1 does not descend an embedded surface.

passes.mechanism: Anti-invariant double-cover cohomology and infinite-dihedral quotients
passes.proved: For every finitely generated G, G surjects D_infinity iff an index-two subgroup has strictly larger b1. This is profinitely invariant. A splice of two trefoil exteriors provides a nonhyperbolic Haken integral homology sphere outside the dihedral criterion.
passes.gap: The hyperbolic Haken rational-homology-sphere case need not be supplied with the necessary double-cover Betti jump by these arguments.

passes.mechanism: Finite-image representation transport and character-curve detection
passes.proved: Equality of trace functions transports through completions over algebraic closures of finite fields. Finite versus infinite character sets, hence existence of a curve, is detected for finitely presented groups.
passes.gap: No converse asserting that every Haken manifold has a character curve in some characteristic. Finite-field samples cannot establish the universal curve condition.

passes.mechanism: Nonintegral traces and Bruhat-Tits fixed-point obstruction
passes.proved: A negative trace valuation forbids a fixed lattice vertex. An exact mod-7 certificate proves a literature trace polynomial irreducible and its roots nonintegral.
passes.gap: The arithmetic certificate does not independently realize the trace in a manifold; not every Haken manifold is shown to have such a trace, and unbounded representations do not extend continuously to completions.

passes.mechanism: Surface splitting transfer and discrete recovery from profinite subgroup data
passes.proved: A closed direct summand in Zhat squared has trivial intersection with the dense integer lattice; a profinite automorphism can produce it. Density alone cannot reconstruct the required discrete subgroup.
passes.gap: Must reconstruct an ordinary tree splitting or prove an additional freeness/discrete-lifting theorem in the hyperbolic setting. A profinite tree action alone is insufficient.

final_gap: Transfer a separating incompressible surface for a general closed hyperbolic Haken rational homology sphere beyond the special dihedral, character-curve and nonintegral-trace mechanisms, or construct and certify a profinitely equivalent non-Haken mate.
